verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Boards are documented as workspaces for saving, organizing, and sharing analysis components, and pre-configured Board Templates speed up setup, so shareable dashboards are delivered. The evidence says nothing about the visualization types available on Boards or about dashboard template variables; Board Templates are starter boards, not parameterized variables. Missing for 10: evidence of rich visualization types, template/dashboard variables, dashboards-as-code management of Boards via API, and independent corroboration.
